text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Ember Labs onboarding shows a rapid activation surge: ~3.2x token burn in 48h after enabling semantic search. Need a tight QBR slide for Monday: root cause, 30d spend scenarios, recommended retainer amount, and two ops mitigations. Who can own numbers?
Diego Rivera: I got this. Will export route-level tokens + model-variant share and p95. ETA 3pm.
Ana Gomez: Ill produce three spend scenarios (baseline, ramp, surge) and model renewal impact. Need current credits/retainer on account.
Priya Singh: Ill draft short enablement notes: client-side batching, context trimming, and a fallback to emb-quant-lite. Also suggest a soft throttle policy.
Maria Chen: They reported embedding p95 ~410ms and occasional 504s. Please open a product ticket for latency.
Diego Rivera: Quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT route, model, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95
FROM usage
WHERE account='ember' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route, model;
```
Diego Rivera: Early dump: embeddings routes = 81% tokens; emb-large p95 ~420ms; emb-quant-lite <4% usage.
Ana Gomez: Preliminary scenarios:
- baseline: +22% next 30d
- ramp: +60% next 30d
- surge: +135% next 30d if current cadence persists
Uploading ember_forecast_v1.csv to account folder.
Priya Singh: Proposed ops mitigations for slide: 1) soft throttle on embeddings (configurable limit), 2) automatic fallback to emb-quant-lite when p95 > 350ms, 3) quick enablement walkthrough for their engineers.
Diego Rivera: Sample throttle JSON for ops to include:
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_tokens_per_min":220000,"fallback":"emb-quant-lite","alert_on":"p95>350ms"}
qbr-bot: Reminder — QBR decks due in #qbr-drafts by Mon 09:00 PST.
Maria Chen: @Ana can you confirm the retainer ask by EOD? Ill slot the number in the deck.
Ana Gomez: Recommend 4k one-time credits (covers ~35 days under ramp). Uploaded amortization table: ember_retainer_calc.csv
Diego Rivera: Created ticket CS-4129 with route CSV attached: ember_route_tokens_30d.csv and linked product latency ticket.
Priya Singh: Scheduling a 20m enablement for Ember devs tomorrow 11:00 PT. Also added SDK batching snippet to the enablement doc.
Maria Chen: Great — Ill assemble the slide and send a draft. Closing unless blockers.
